source.locator: Coverage of NVIDIA's April 14, 2025 blog post; corroborated in the Q1 FY2026 release: 'Announced that NVIDIA is building factories in the U.S. and working with its partners to produce NVIDIA AI supercomputers in the U.S.'
source.quote: Now, in an April 14 blog post shared on its website, Nvidia announced that it will be greatly expanding its U.S.-based manufacturing capabilities, pouring $500 billion in investment into production facilities in Arizona and Texas.
source.title: Nvidia To Build $500 Billion in AI Manufacturing Infrastructure in US, Supercomputers in America for the First Time | RetailWire

events.speaker: Jensen Huang
events.speakerCapacity: Founder and CEO, quoted on NVIDIA's April 14, 2025 U.S. manufacturing announcement
events.summary: NVIDIA announced it would expand U.S. manufacturing with $500 billion of AI infrastructure investment in production facilities in Arizona and Texas over four years. Blackwell chips were already in production at TSMC's Phoenix plants; supercomputer plants were under construction in Houston (with Foxconn) and Dallas (with Wistron), with mass production expected to increase in scope over the next 12 to 15 months. Huang: 'The engines of the world's AI infrastructure are being built in the United States for the first time.'

lineages.fulfillmentTest: By April 14, 2029 (four years from the April 14, 2025 announcement), NVIDIA has produced AI infrastructure in the United States cumulatively valued at up to $500 billion. Interim milestone: mass production increasing in scope at the Texas supercomputer plants (Houston/Foxconn, Dallas/Wistron) within 12–15 months of the announcement (by ~July 2026).
lineages.title: Up to $500B of U.S.-produced AI infrastructure over four years

source.locator: Source: NVIDIA (GlobeNewswire release hosted on Nasdaq)
source.quote: HUMAIN, a subsidiary of Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund focused on AI, is making a major investment to build AI factories in KSA with a projected capacity of up to 500 megawatts powered by several hundred thousand of NVIDIA's most advanced GPUs over the next five years. source.title: Saudi Arabia and NVIDIA to Build AI Factories to Power Next Wave of Intelligence for the Age of Reasoning | Nasdaq

events.speaker: Jensen Huang
events.speakerCapacity: Founder and CEO, NVIDIA–Saudi Arabia AI partnership announcement (state visit with the U.S. President and the Saudi Crown Prince)
events.summary: NVIDIA and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia announced partnerships to build AI factories: HUMAIN to invest in up to 500MW of AI factory capacity powered by several hundred thousand NVIDIA GPUs over five years, with a first phase of 18,000 NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell supercomputers; separately, the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA) to deploy up to 5,000 Blackwell GPUs for a sovereign AI factory. events.targetValue: up to 500 megawatts over five years

lineages.fulfillmentTest: By May 13, 2030 (five years from the announcement), the HUMAIN partnership delivers AI factory capacity in Saudi Arabia of up to 500MW powered by several hundred thousand NVIDIA GPUs; first phase includes an 18,000-GPU NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell AI supercomputer with InfiniBand networking deployed.
lineages.title: HUMAIN partnership: up to 500MW of AI factories in Saudi Arabia over five years
